title: •BoShek
caption: •BoShek (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. Deploys -2 to Cantina, a docking bay, or a starship. BoShek is a matching pilot for any starship. Twice per game, may ▲ a device. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Rogue pilot. Outlaw starship tech. Has secret lab in Mos Eisley. He bragged about beating Han Solo’s Kessel Run record. Left fringe life behind after meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi.
